rules.rule_context: Export Control Notice: High-performance thermal imaging cameras are controlled under ECCN 6A003 when their technical specifications meet or exceed the thresholds defined in that entry (detector type, resolution, frame rate, and sensitivity as specified in the EAR). Such items are not EAR99. For any destination in Country Group D:1 or E:1, a confirmed ECCN classification and a license or license exception assessment by Trade Compliance are required before export authorization. Reps must not self-classify controlled items as EAR99. Trade Compliance review applies to any item whose specifications fall within ECCN 6A003 scope, regardless of quote timeline.
